name: writelikeyou
description: By AITYTECH -- detects AI-writing tells and runs real grammar/spelling/style checking on English, Vietnamese, and Japanese text -- deterministic rule engines only, no third-party AI service ever sees your text.
long_description: Built by AITYTECH (github.com/aitytech). WriteLikeYou lints a draft for stock AI-writing tells (hedging, hype phrases, structural cliches, AI self-disclosure) across English, Vietnamese, and Japanese, and layers real engines on top: Harper for English grammar/spelling (~823 rules), Vale for English style-guide checking (weasel words, wordiness, passive voice), real Vietnamese spelling via nspell + a Vietnamese dictionary, and Japanese grammar/register/proofreading checks (particle repetition, dearu/desumasu consistency, notation unification) via a from-scratch Suzume-based morphological pipeline. Every finding names the exact rule and text span, and nothing is sent to any AI model or third-party service -- every check here is a deterministic rule engine running locally in this extension's own process.

tools.name: lint_text
tools.description: Detects AI-writing tells and runs real grammar/spelling/style checking on English, Vietnamese, or Japanese text.

tools.name: list_rules
tools.description: Lists the rules lint_text can flag for a given language.

tools.name: compare_text
tools.description: Lints two versions of the same draft and reports whether an edit actually reduced AI-writing tells.
